reviews.text: I looked it up because I was curious after seeing the reviews, but I should have looked more closely. I didn't see any bad posts, but as expected, regardless of the pros and cons of the fortune teller, I feel bad because their attitude is so bad. I've seen the fortune teller a few times, if not a lot, but this is my first time at a place like this. They spoke in a half-hearted manner, and there was no time to ask questions. They cut off the consultation by saying that they answered the phone midway, but they explained the fortune telling service as if they were ignoring it.  It cost a few thousand won in 10 minutes. Save that money. Just eat something delicious and sleep well;;;;

reviews.author: Kiyoung
reviews.text:
I just don't know how to look at the fortune teller itself.
At first, some characters were used so that people would not recognize them.
Ask vague questions and answer questions
He speaks as if inferring.
For example, did you date last year or not?
If you did it, you had good luck with love last year.
Did you do it in April? Did you do it in July? If it's June
We were meant to be in April, but we met a little late, or we met quickly in July.
A place where people play around with someone else's orders like this
They must be truly punished and destroyed.

reviews.author: Yejin Yoo
reviews.text: I've always been interested in fortune telling, so to be honest, I wasn't very sincere during the consultation, and there were some things that were right in terms of personality, but why didn't you explain the flow of Yongshin, Daeun, and Seun, which are the most important in fortune telling? On the contrary, I don't think it's a brave thing... And now, my luck has changed to a fortune, and if the fortune comes in, I think there will be a possibility of marriage in my mid to late 20s, but it's so absurd that you say so clearly that there is no luck in getting married in your 20s... And I think you're giving too vague an explanation about your spouse.

1.Is this a cafe? Is it a bookstore? Is it a cultural center? In the end, it is a hip space where you can do all kinds of things, but ultimately, I think it would be better to see it as a cafe.
2. Rather than a cafe frequently visited by tourists or travelers, it is a place full of semi-locals who truly understand the Hongdae sensibility.
3. The table itself is uncomfortable and the spacing is not wide, so it is not a comfortable space to be honest. If it's summer, you can still use the outdoor sofa table for ample use.
4. Although there are not a few types, the variety of drinks and desserts is average. The coffee itself has a strong acidity.
5. They sell a variety of design products, but they are generally expensive and people don't seem to go beyond looking at them to actually purchasing them, so it feels like a kind of sales display stand is just an interior accessory.

👍Recommendation: Hongdae locals who want to spend the weekend with a laptop

reviews.text: The layout of the terraced seating area is similar to Starbucks in Jongno Tower. Compared to Starbucks near Hongik University Station, there are more seats, but the tiered seats are not as comfortable, so if you need to work on a laptop, it would be a good idea to come early and reserve a window seat.

reviews.author: Philosophizing
reviews.text:
Reserve Starbucks located near Hongik University Station!!
The taste of micro blend coffee beans is great every time you taste it.
The atmosphere and luxury of this store were also very good.

reviews.author: Eunhee Kim
reviews.text:
The best Starbucks at Hongdae intersection.
The taste and aroma of the coffee is of the highest quality.
He seems to be building a career that he can recommend to anyone, and the staff is very friendly.

reviews.author: Ji Wan-ho
reviews.text: Friendly customer service, spacious space, tiered seating for one person, a variety of table and sofa seats, and ample space in each space make you a frequent visitor. Today too, latte, Americano, salt bread... Lovely Place!!

reviews.author: travel copper
reviews.text: I don't know much, it's just good. The comfortable seats are occupied by people who arrived early and have hardly ever sat down. However, the atmosphere inside is spacious and nice. It feels like I'm in a library in Sydney. The seating arrangement is also unique. I'm deducting one star because the employees seem to chat among themselves and the service is an afterthought.😉
